text: {"question":"Which calculation in the paper demonstrates that the correction to the Hubble constant from a local McVittie mass is negligible, even for the largest plausible coupling parameter?","reference_answer":"The paper derives a linearized expression for the inferred Hubble constant from the CMB angular scale, showing that Hinferred = Htrue(1−0.13 μ). For the maximum μ≈3.91×10⁻⁴ this yields a correction of only 0.13 μ≈5×10⁻⁶, confirming the negligible effect of a local mass on H₀."}
